brief: Insert values at the front of an array
description: Insert one or more values at the beginning of a mutable array, preserving the relative order of the inserted values. Returns the new length of the array. The array must not be immutable (for example after freeze).

parameters.description: Target array. Must not be immutable.
parameters.name: array

parameters.description: Values to insert at the front, in order.
parameters.name: values

returns.description: The new length of the array.
